slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover looping muted autoplay hero background video sitting behind the clip-path reveal.

Orbit of 6 product/bottle images circling an elliptical path; rendered object-contain on a circular mask, so each needs a transparent or seamless background. Each image pairs with a title + desc copy slot.
Decorative full-width botanical illustration pinned to the bottom of StaySection (object-cover, center bottom); transparent PNG layered over the white section background.
Inline header logo glyph (currently a hand-drawn winged crest with an embedded italic 'B'); fills with currentColor so it tints to the fg color — swap for the brand mark.

mechanic: An ellipse clip-path reveal driven by a 600vh sticky-scroll progress expands a white panel over a looping hero video while a counter-rotating image orbit scales up, fans out, and translates across the viewport, then collapses back.
techDelivery: Single-file CDN: Tailwind Play CDN + @babel/standalone in-browser JSX + esm.sh React 18.3.1 with framer-motion 11.18.2 as ES modules.
reskinNotes: Brand colors are hardcoded as inline-style hex/rgba and Tailwind utility classes throughout the JSX (not CSS variables), so reskinning requires editing many literal #000/#ffffff/#f4ecdc/rgba(0,0,0,*) occurrences. Font-family strings are repeated inline in dozens of style objects rather than referenced from the Tailwind theme tokens. The Bentley wordmark is a hand-drawn inline SVG with an embedded italic 'B' text node using Instrument Serif and a fixed currentColor fill. All copy (headlines, nav, footer columns, orbit titles/descs, captions, social labels) is hardcoded in markup. Orbit geometry (radii, item sizes, focal scaling) is tuned to 6 items and a square aspect; changing the image count shifts the spacing. Great Vibes (accent/script) is loaded and configured but not actually rendered in the markup.
